content.comment_body: Hello, I've been using [product_name] daily, but today it crashed and won't start. I've reinstalled [product_name], applied a JAVA patch, and restarted Windows several times with no success. My system specs are: Windows 11, [product_name] [version_no]. Does anyone know how to resolve this? Please advise. Best regards, [user_name]
Which version of [product_name] are you using?
I checked the Online Help for [product_name] [version_no]. [company_name] has not tested or released [product_name] for Windows 11.
That's right. It was running for a few months until this issue.
Unfortunately, I can't assist with this problem. If no one else has a solution, you might want to submit a support request.

Could you share a link to the operating system compatibility list? Perhaps I need to try running it on a virtual Linux system. Has it been tested with Windows 8 or Windows 10? I could run those in a virtual machine. I'm interested in joining the software team—where can I find information about the [company_name] software department? It would be helpful if they could migrate [product_name] from Java to Electron to improve compatibility across different operating systems.
Please find attached the list of tested operating systems. I don't have answers for your other questions.

I've installed VirtualBox 7.0, downloaded Windows 10 from Microsoft, and set up [product_name] [version_no] there. So far, everything works well and online monitoring is enabled. Best regards, [user_name]
Consider looking towards Chengdu... Different technologies—migrating could be quite complex.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced a crash with [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 11, blocking program startup. Even though it had worked previously, [company_name] hasn't officially supported or tested this version on Windows 11. The issue was resolved by running the software on a supported OS (Windows 10) via a virtual machine, which worked effectively. The discussion highlights user concern about compatibility and the need for improved cross-platform support as operating systems evolve.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to run reliably on modern Windows versions, especially Windows 11, and is seeking better cross-platform compatibility through updated technology.
